channel.title: Vacationist Blog — Group Travel Planning Guides
channel.description: Practical guides on planning group trips, splitting travel expenses, and coordinating friends, families, and teams — from the makers of Vacationist.

item.title: How to Split Travel Expenses Fairly — The Complete Guide (2026)
item.description: The complete guide to splitting travel expenses in a group: what counts as shared, fair methods for unequal situations, tracking systems, and settling up without awkwardness.

item.title: How to Plan a Group Trip Without Losing Your Mind — The Complete Guide (2026)
item.description: The definitive guide to planning a group trip: picking dates, choosing a destination, making decisions without arguments, splitting costs fairly, and surviving as the organizer.

item.title: Group Camping Trip Planning — Gear, Food, and Costs for the Whole Crew (2026)

item.title: Family Vacation Coordination — Planning Trips Across Multiple Households (2026)

item.title: How to Plan a Bachelorette Trip for a Big Group — The Complete Playbook (2026)
